title: ArbiterAgentReturn
description: Generic agent-return envelope (M8 core + M12 citation enforcement). Every review/verify/skeptic sub-agent hands back this shape; the orchestrator records it via scripts/record-agent-return.mjs and validates it via scripts/check-agent-return.mjs. A structural finding without a resolvable file:line citation is rejected at the tool layer (M12). Enforced by INV-138 (advisory at land-time, promoted on owner ratification — design §0).

agent.description: Name of the agent that produced this return (e.g. 'red-team', 'context-checker').

role.description: Role the agent played in this dispatch.

taskId.description: Task identifier in GitHub issue format, e.g. '#1943'.

branch.description: Git branch the agent worked on (stamped by the recorder, never trusted from input).

sha.description: Git commit sha the envelope was produced against (stamped by the recorder).

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the recorder stamped this envelope.

verdict.description: Top-level verdict the agent returns to the orchestrator.

confidence.description: Agent self-reported confidence in its verdict, 0.0 to 1.0.

findings.description: Findings. A structural finding MUST carry >=1 resolvable citation (enforced by the validator, not the schema alone).

refutations.description: Optional refutation verdicts (E2/M13). Skeptics targeting a finding id record UPHELD or REFUTED.

evidenceRefs.description: Optional paths under .arbiter/evidence/ backing this return.

provenance.description: Optional dispatch provenance stamped by the recorder, never trusted from agent input.

id.description: Stable fingerprint id for this finding (used by refutations and the dry-pass ledger).

kind.description: Finding kind. 'structural' findings require >=1 resolvable citation (M12).

citations.description: Citations backing the claim. Required non-empty for kind:'structural' (enforced by validator).

line.description: 1-based line number. Validator resolves the file at the envelope sha and checks line <= file length.

target.description: id of the finding this skeptic verdict targets.
